using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests;

public class SuiteCommandTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly SuiteCommand _suiteCommand;

    public SuiteCommandTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
        _mockLogger.SetupAllProperties();

        // Create dependencies with mocks
        var cmdHelper = new Mock<ICmdHelper>().Object;
        var nugetService = new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>(new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object).Object;
        var packageChecker = new Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService>().Object;
        var authService = new Mock<AuthService>().Object;
        var httpFactory = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object;
        var suiteSettings = new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>().Object;

        _suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
            nugetService,
            packageChecker,
            cmdHelper,
            authService,
            httpFactory,
            suiteSettings
        )
        {
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand_ShouldLogInformationMessage()
    {
        // Act
        _suiteCommand.ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand();

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    fs => fs.ToString().Contains("dotnet tool install -g Volo.Abp.Suite --add-source https://nuget.abp.io/<your-private-key>/v3/index.json")
                ),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
            ),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InstallSuiteAsync_SuccessfulInstall_ShouldLogSuccessMessages()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockCmdHelper = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
        mockCmdHelper.Setup(x => x.RunCmd(It.IsAny<string>(), out It.Ref<int>.IsAny))
                     .Callback<string, int>((cmd, exitCode) => exitCode = 0);
        
        var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
            new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>().Object,
            new Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService>().Object,
            mockCmdHelper.Object,
            new Mock<AuthService>().Object,
            new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object,
            new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>().Object
        )
        {
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object
        };

        // Act
        suiteCommand.InstallSuiteAsync().Wait();

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogInformation("ABP Suite has been successfully installed."),
            Times.Once
        );
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogInformation("You can run it with the CLI command \"abp suite\""),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InstallSuiteAsync_FailedInstall_ShouldCallShowSuiteManualInstallCommand()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockCmdHelper = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
        mockCmdHelper.Setup(x => x.RunCmd(It.IsAny<string>(), out It.Ref<int>.IsAny))
                     .Callback<string, int>((cmd, exitCode) => exitCode = 1);

        var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
            new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>().Object,
            new Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService>().Object,
            mockCmdHelper.Object,
            new Mock<AuthService>().Object,
            new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object,
            new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>().Object
        )
        {
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object
        };

        // Act
        suiteCommand.InstallSuiteAsync().Wait();

        // Assert - Verify ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand was called (which logs the target line)
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    fs => fs.ToString().Contains("dotnet tool install -g Volo.Abp.Suite --add-source https://nuget.abp.io/<your-private-key>/v3/index.json")
                ),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
            ),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InstallSuiteAsync_ExceptionThrown_ShouldLogErrorAndCallShowSuiteManualInstallCommand()
    {
        // Arrange
        var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
            new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>().Object,
            new Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService>().Object,
            new Mock<ICmdHelper>().Object,
            new Mock<AuthService>().Object,
            new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object,
            new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>().Object
        )
        {
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object
        };

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<AggregateException>(() => suiteCommand.InstallSuiteAsync().Wait());

        // Verify error was logged and ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand was called
        _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogError(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Once);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    fs => fs.ToString().Contains("dotnet tool install -g Volo.Abp.Suite")
                ),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
            ),
            Times.Once
        );
    }
}
